title: Tong-2021-ripples-10.7554/elife.68401
description: This derivative dataset repackages the authors' figure-level arrays from a study of ripples in the human anterior temporal lobe. It includes iEEG, micro-LFP and sorted single-unit data from 96-channel Utah microelectrode arrays, recorded in epilepsy patients during a paired-associates verbal memory task. The arrays cover ripple-band signals, time-frequency power, ripple rasters, spike indices and pairwise phase consistency, and reproduce panels of Figures 1-4 of the original article. Raw continuous recordings are not included.
methods_description: Participants with drug-resistant epilepsy had subdural and depth contacts, and some also had 96-channel microelectrode arrays in the anterior temporal lobe. iEEG was sampled at 1000 Hz, with detrending and line-noise removal. Morlet wavelet power was computed, and retrieval epochs ran from 4 s before to 1 s after vocalization. Ripples were detected with an 80-120 Hz band-pass and a Hilbert envelope threshold. Single units were obtained by threshold crossing and manual spike sorting.
